title: 桑伯里泥炭沼预交割合规风险
instruction:
您是 Thornbury Studios 的门诊业务总监，支持其购买由 Peatmoor Solutions 运营的德克萨斯州内窥镜中心。索尔维格·辛克莱 (Solveig Sinclair) 需要在交易顾问本周五起草陈述和保证时间表之前提供可供决策的合规视图，距离交易还有三周时间。数据室里有大约 600 页的付款人合同、德克萨斯州设施和联邦实验室记录、三年的麻醉人员配置协议、旧的 OIG 审计函和提供者文件，但她不想要尽职调查索引或所有可能错误的通用列表。她只想要能够合理改变价格、成为成交条件或需要特定陈述、保证、赔偿或托管的风险敞口。从 3 月1、2025 开始准备工作，应用与德克萨斯州门诊手术中心及其联邦计划参与相关的要求。该摘要将发送给非专业投资委员会成员和顾问，因此它必须是可以理解的，而无需假设医疗保健合规词汇。
您需要解决一些紧张局势，而不是简单地重复。麻醉小组在过去九个月内没有记录其临床医生的排除筛查情况，尽管其管理人员表示年度合同证明就足够了。运营团队认为这是廉价的内务管理，而法律顾问则担心已经收费的服务。合规副总裁还表示，已确认的排除匹配不太可能值得与普通筛查补救措施分开进行治疗。州法律顾问指出，当前的德克萨斯州设施许可证已颁发给卖方，并且不会在所有权变更时自动转让，但整合计划假设从交易结束后的第一个早上开始不间断运营。一些付款人协议涵盖了预计案例的42%，并包含尚未解决的控制权变更、转让或通知语言。卖方指出，一份已有七年历史的 OIG 审计结案信作为证据，表明不需要历史合规陈述。该中心的有限实验室测试还有 CLIA 证书，一些提供者文件中的认证材料老化，并且没有关于 Medicare 注册、认证或付款人参与结束时发生的情况的综合账户。
请出示两份文件：(1) `preclosing_compliance_exposure_summary.docx`，仅限一页，优先考虑与交易相关的风险敞口，说明每个文件需要哪些交易保护，并明确已知的内容与仍需要确认的内容； (2) `deal_exposure_forecast.xlsx`，可编辑的 90 天估计，显示基础、预期和下行情景。对于预测，使用均匀分布在 90 天的1,100 计划案例、每个案例$640 的边际贡献、每个场景中的 $18,000 排除筛选补救成本，以及分别为 0、30 和 60 天的许可延迟假设。从中心合法开放的第一天开始计算，支付者同意的滞后时间为0、45 和90 天。在等待同意的开放日期间，仅将付款人问题应用于42%受影响的案件数量，并为这些案件的边际贡献减少55%建模。如果无法获得必要的索赔事实，请勿将假定的美元价值分配给还款、罚款、法律费用或和解风险；在没有制造精度的情况下识别不确定性。
两个文件必须就它们共享的每一个数据达成一致，包括用于决策的90日情景暴露。将 Word 文档保留为材料调用，而不是背景教育，并使电子表格足够透明，以便 Oona Voskresensky 可以更改假设而无需重建它。将这两个文件写入您启动的工作目录的顶层，并使用上面的文件名。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `preclosing_compliance_exposure_summary.docx` — 与价格、成交条件或协议保护相关的合规风险的一页、简明语言的成交前摘要。 （必须不超过一个渲染页面，截至 3 月1、2025 是最新的，解决德克萨斯州事务，区分已知事实和未解决的问题，并在工作目录顶层准确使用指定的文件名。）
- `deal_exposure_forecast.xlsx` — 可编辑90日已识别运营合规风险的基准、预期和下行估计。 （必须使用可编辑的假设和公式，不得将不受支持的值分配给还款、罚款、法律费用或和解，必须与 Word 摘要中的每个共享数字一致，并且必须准确使用工作目录顶层指定的文件名。）
除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: 值与公式提取，不还原原始排版；每表最多120行、30列。

sheets.name: 90-Day Forecast
rows: Editable assumptions and 90-day operating exposure | as of 1-Mar-2025
Pending period starts on first lawful open day
Repayments, penalties, legal fees, settlements, and exclusion-related claims are not assigned dollar values; amounts remain unquantified pending screening, claims, and counsel review.
Model check: payer impairment is capped to open days, so cases lost during license closure are not double-counted.

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
THORNBURY STUDIOS | PRE-CLOSING COMPLIANCE EXPOSURE
Texas endoscopy center acquisition — decision brief as of March 1, 2025
Priority / status
Known vs. confirm
Deal consequence
Protection, owner & timing
1 • STOP/GO
License
KNOWN: Texas facility license is in seller name and does not automatically transfer on change of ownership. OPEN: buyer application/authorization effective date; separate CLIA update, accreditation and Medicare ASC enrollment/supplier filing.
Without effective buyer authority, closing does not make operations lawful; closed days lose planned contribution margin.
Closing condition: effective license or written regulator authorization. Licensing counsel owns now; operations keeps center closed or delays closing. Confirm CLIA, Medicare and accreditor separately.
2 • HIGH
Payers
KNOWN: unresolved assignment/change-of-control/notice language affects 42% of projected cases. OPEN: contract-specific consent, rates and effective dates.
Participation or rates may not continue; while consent is pending, affected cases carry a modeled 55% contribution-margin reduction. Modeled 90-day total: Base $18,000; Expected $333,979; Downside $541,541.
Payer contracting + counsel obtain consents/amendments before closing; condition or escrow for unresolved material payers. Finance updates forecast; no assumed repayment, penalty or legal-fee dollars.
3 • HIGH
Anesthesia
KNOWN: no documented exclusion screening for contracted clinicians for nine months. Annual vendor attestation is not a substitute for current checks or ongoing monitoring. OPEN: any excluded person and affected claims/payments.
Excluded-person services can threaten billing, program participation and contracts; this is more than housekeeping. A confirmed match is a distinct severe event.
Compliance screens group, entities and personnel against OIG LEIE, SAM and Texas Medicaid source before close and monthly thereafter; seller/anesthesia vendor certifies and buyer retains evidence/audit rights. Match: verify, suspend affected duties/billing, look back dates/services/claims/payments, then counsel-led disclosure/repayment review. Schedule exclusion/billing reps, indemnity/escrow and vendor cure/termination rights.
4 • MEDIUM
History/files
KNOWN: seven-year-old OIG audit closure letter; aging credential files. OPEN: audit scope, corrective-action/refund/reporting/continuing duties; current licenses, privileges, recredentialing and payer enrollment.
Old closure is not blanket proof of current compliance or no unrelated exposure; each provider prerequisite must be current before furnishing or billing.
Deal counsel confirms scope/closure evidence; compliance/medical staff verifies providers and payer enrollment before close. Targeted reps: material compliance, licenses/participation, exclusions, billing/overpayments, investigations and data-room accuracy; indemnity/escrow for identified unknowns.
Decision requested this week: authorize counsel to draft targeted representations, a licensing closing condition, and risk-based indemnity/escrow; require the owners above to deliver confirmations before Friday schedule drafting. Forecast excludes unquantified repayments, penalties, settlements and legal fees pending facts.

criteria.description: 提交的 Word 可交付成果位于顶层，文件名为 `preclosing_compliance_exposure_summary.docx`，并作为有效的 DOCX 文件打开。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认确切的文件名、位置、扩展名，以及该文件是否可以打开和检查。

original.criterion: The submitted Word deliverable exists at the top level under the exact filename `preclosing_compliance_exposure_summary.docx` and opens as a valid DOCX file.
original.evidence: Submitted working directory and DOCX package.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the exact filename, location, extension, and that the file can be opened and inspected.

criteria.description: 提交的预测位于顶层，文件名为 `deal_exposure_forecast.xlsx`，并作为有效的 XLSX 工作簿打开。
criteria.evidence: 提交的工作目录和 XLSX 包。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认确切的文件名、位置、扩展名，以及可以打开和检查工作簿。

original.criterion: The submitted forecast exists at the top level under the exact filename `deal_exposure_forecast.xlsx` and opens as a valid XLSX workbook.
original.evidence: Submitted working directory and XLSX package.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the exact filename, location, extension, and that the workbook can be opened and inspected.

criteria.description: 呈现的合规暴露摘要不超过一页。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准 Office 渲染器渲染 DOCX 并计数页面；内容溢出到第二页将导致此项目失败。

original.criterion: The rendered compliance exposure summary occupies no more than one page.
original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX using a standard office renderer and count pages; content spilling to a second page fails this item.

criteria.description: 摘要将德克萨斯州确定为相关州司法管辖区，并注明截止日期为 3 月1、2025。
criteria.grader_hint: 在可见文档中查找管辖区和日期，而不仅仅是在元数据中。

original.criterion: The summary identifies Texas as the relevant state jurisdiction and states an as-of date of March 1, 2025.
original.grader_hint: Look for both the jurisdiction and the date in the visible document, not only in metadata.

criteria.description: 该摘要采用了严格的交易重要性过滤器，并不解读为通用的尽职调查清单。
criteria.grader_hint: 当页面集中于能够改变经济状况、成交准备情况或合同风险分配的事项并忽略不影响交易的常规背景时授予该奖项。

original.criterion: The summary applies a disciplined deal-materiality filter and does not read as a generic diligence inventory.
original.grader_hint: Award when the page concentrates on matters capable of changing economics, closing readiness, or contractual risk allocation and omits routine background that does not affect the transaction.

criteria.description: 该摘要明确将风险敞口与可用的交易杠杆联系起来：价格或量化经济学、成交条件以及特定协议保护，例如陈述、赔偿或托管。
criteria.grader_hint: 必须代表所有三类交易杠杆，尽管并非每个风险敞口都需要全部三类。

original.criterion: The summary expressly connects exposures to the available deal levers: price or quantified economics, closing conditions, and specific agreement protections such as representations, indemnities, or escrow.
original.grader_hint: All three classes of deal lever must be represented, although not every exposure needs all three.

criteria.description: 这些风险显然是按交易结果排列优先级的，而不是以无差别的列表的形式呈现。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受排名、紧急程度或其他明确的层次结构，这些层次结构会在例行清理之前放置潜在的无法操作和重大历史计费风险。

original.criterion: The exposures are visibly prioritized by transaction consequence rather than presented as an undifferentiated list.
original.grader_hint: Accept ranking, urgency tiers, or another clear hierarchy that places potential inability to operate and material historical billing risk ahead of routine cleanup.

criteria.description: 摘要始终将已确认的事实与公开的尽职调查问题区分开来，并避免将信息差距转化为事实违规。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查限定符和状态标签。筛查文件失效可能会得到确认，而实际的排除人员账单、还款责任或未解决的同意后果仍然是有条件的，除非得到支持。

original.criterion: The summary consistently distinguishes confirmed facts from open diligence questions and avoids converting an information gap into a factual violation.
original.grader_hint: Inspect qualifiers and status labels. A screening documentation lapse may be confirmed, while actual excluded-person billing, repayment liability, or unresolved consent consequences remain conditional unless supported.

criteria.description: 为期九个月的麻醉排除筛查文件失误被确定为与交易相关的暴露，而不仅仅是管理记录缺陷。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找持续时间、签约麻醉劳动力背景以及与交易风险的联系。

original.criterion: The nine-month anesthesia exclusion-screening documentation lapse is identified as a deal-relevant exposure rather than merely an administrative record defect.
original.grader_hint: Look for the duration, the contracted anesthesia workforce context, and linkage to transaction risk.

criteria.description: 拟议的筛查治疗涵盖相关签约临床医生和实体，而不仅仅是中心的直接员工。
criteria.evidence: DOCX 麻醉暴露和建议的保护。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当范围明确涉及麻醉小组及其人员或以其他方式涵盖提供计费服务的承包商时才授予奖项。

original.criterion: The proposed screening cure covers relevant contracted clinicians and entities, not just the center’s direct employees.
original.evidence: DOCX anesthesia exposure and proposed protection.
original.grader_hint: Award only if the scope clearly reaches the anesthesia group and its personnel or otherwise encompasses contractors furnishing billable services.

criteria.description: 该摘要积极拒绝依赖年度供应商认证来充分替代当前的排除检查和持续监控。
criteria.grader_hint: 存在证明的中立声明是不够的。该文件必须表明证明或仅年度审查并不能充分控制风险。

original.criterion: The summary actively rejects reliance on an annual vendor attestation as a sufficient substitute for current exclusion checks and ongoing monitoring.
original.grader_hint: A neutral statement that an attestation exists is insufficient. The document must advise that attestation or annual-only review does not adequately control the risk.

criteria.description: 筛查响应要求根据 OIG 排除个人/实体名单、SAM 和适用的德克萨斯州医疗补助排除来源进行检查。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果在上下文中可以理解，则可以使用诸如 LEIE 之类的常见缩写；所有三个源类别都必须存在。

original.criterion: The screening response calls for checks against the OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities, SAM, and the applicable Texas Medicaid exclusion source.
original.grader_hint: Common abbreviations such as LEIE are acceptable if understandable in context; all three source categories must be present.

criteria.description: 交割后控制规定每月进行持续的排除筛查，而不仅仅是一次性的交割前检查。
criteria.evidence: DOCX 控制或协议保护语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 在立即回顾治疗后寻找适用的明确的每月节奏。

original.criterion: The post-close control specifies ongoing monthly exclusion screening rather than only a one-time pre-closing check.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit monthly cadence applicable after the immediate lookback cure.

criteria.description: 摘要通过证据、审计权、认证或其他可验证的控制措施保留买方对委托供应商筛选的监督。
criteria.grader_hint: 当责任不能通过外包而消失时的奖励；仅仅承诺麻醉小组将负责筛查是不够的。

original.criterion: The summary preserves buyer oversight of delegated vendor screening through evidence, audit rights, certification, or another verifiable control.
original.grader_hint: Award when responsibility cannot disappear through outsourcing; a bare promise that the anesthesia group will handle screening is not enough.

criteria.description: 麻醉失效与可能的账单、付款、参与和合同后果按比例相关，但不主张责任已经确定。
criteria.grader_hint: 措辞应传达为什么失误很重要，同时保留有条件的语言，等待实际筛选和索赔审查。

original.criterion: The anesthesia lapse is linked proportionately to possible billing, payment, participation, and contractual consequences without asserting that liability has already been established.
original.grader_hint: The wording should convey why the lapse matters while retaining conditional language pending actual screening and claims review.

criteria.description: 已确认或可信的排除匹配被视为明显的严重异常，需要立即验证并暂停受影响的职责或计费待解决，而不是纳入例行补救措施。
criteria.evidence: DOCX 麻醉暴露或异常语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当页面为比赛提供单独的升级路径并且不将其仅视为另一条缺失的筛选记录时才授予奖励。

original.criterion: A confirmed or credible exclusion match is treated as a distinct, severe exception requiring immediate verification and suspension from affected duties or billing pending resolution, rather than being folded into routine remediation.
original.evidence: DOCX anesthesia exposure or exception language.
original.grader_hint: Award only if the page provides a separate escalation path for a match and does not treat it as merely another missing screening record.

criteria.description: 对已确认匹配的响应包括对受影响日期、服务、索赔和付款的回顾。
criteria.evidence: DOCX 异常或交易保护语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找与排除期相关的回顾性索赔/付款分析，而不仅仅是预期的移除。

original.criterion: The response to a confirmed match includes a lookback over affected dates, services, claims, and payments.
original.grader_hint: Look for a retrospective claims/payment analysis tied to the period of exclusion, not merely prospective removal.

criteria.description: 该摘要通过基于事实的法律和合规审查来路由任何已识别的超额付款、披露或偿还问题，而不会发明偿还或罚款金额。
criteria.evidence: DOCX 麻醉暴露和任何金钱讨论。
criteria.grader_hint: 当承认潜在的报告或退款义务但未说明无支持的责任数字或明确的法律结论时授予奖励。

original.criterion: The summary routes any identified overpayment, disclosure, or repayment question through a fact-based legal and compliance review without inventing a repayment or penalty amount.
original.evidence: DOCX anesthesia exposure and any monetary discussion.
original.grader_hint: Award when potential reporting or refund duties are recognized but no unsupported liability figure or categorical legal conclusion is stated.

criteria.description: 该摘要正确地将德克萨斯州设施许可证标识为在所有权变更时不可转让或不可转让，并需要买方采取许可行动。
criteria.grader_hint: 该条目必须拒绝卖方现有设施许可证仅跟随资产的假设。

original.criterion: The summary correctly identifies the Texas facility license as nontransferable or nonassignable on the change of ownership and requiring buyer-side licensing action.
original.grader_hint: The entry must reject the assumption that the seller’s existing facility license simply follows the assets.

criteria.description: 许可风险明确表明，如果所需的买方许可或授权无效，该中心不能仅仅因为交易已结束而合法运营。
criteria.grader_hint: 奖励明确的运营结果。对可能的文书工作延迟的模糊提及是不够的。

original.criterion: The licensing exposure makes clear that the center cannot lawfully operate merely because the transaction has closed if the required buyer license or authorization is not effective.
original.grader_hint: Award for a clear operational consequence. Vague references to possible paperwork delay are insufficient.

criteria.description: 建议将有效的设施许可或令人满意的书面监管授权作为交割条件，而不仅仅是交割后的整合任务。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的关闭条件或与合法运营相关的等效先决条件。

original.criterion: Effective facility licensure or satisfactory written regulatory authorization is proposed as a closing condition rather than only a post-close integration task.
original.grader_hint: Look for an unambiguous condition to closing or equivalent condition precedent tied to legal operation.

criteria.description: 该摘要确定了许可延迟时可执行的意外情况，例如延迟关闭或保持设施关闭，并指定负责的所有者和时间安排。
criteria.grader_hint: 意外事件不得意味着在没有必要授权的情况下可以继续操作，并且必须足够具体以执行。

original.criterion: The summary identifies an executable contingency if licensing is delayed, such as delaying closing or keeping the facility closed, and assigns a responsible owner and timing.
original.grader_hint: The contingency must not imply that operations may continue without required authority and must be concrete enough to execute.

criteria.description: CLIA 所有权变更或证书更新要求与州设施许可证分开处理，在实验室测试继续之前需要确认。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当文件避免暗示解决一个证书会自动解决另一个证书时才授予。

original.criterion: CLIA change-of-ownership or certificate-update requirements are treated separately from state facility licensure, with confirmation required before laboratory testing continues.
original.grader_hint: Award only if the document avoids implying that resolution of one credential automatically resolves the other.

criteria.description: 该摘要单独阐述了 Medicare 登记、ASC 供应商关系以及相关认证的连续性和所需的备案或确认。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件不需要提供表格级别的说明，但不得将州许可视为解决联邦注册或认证的问题。

original.criterion: The summary separately addresses continuity and required filings or confirmations for Medicare enrollment, the ASC supplier relationship, and accreditation where relevant.
original.grader_hint: The document need not provide form-level instructions, but it must not treat state licensure as resolving federal enrollment or accreditation.

criteria.description: 付款人合同风险要求在假设参与或费率继续之前解决控制权变更、分配、通知和同意要求的合同特定解决方案。
criteria.grader_hint: 当页面拒绝全面的连续性假设并将未解决的条款与同意、修订或其他交易保护联系起来时授予奖励。

original.criterion: The payer-contract exposure calls for contract-specific resolution of change-of-control, assignment, notice, and consent requirements before assuming participation or rates continue.
original.grader_hint: Award when the page rejects a blanket continuity assumption and connects unresolved provisions to consent, amendment, or another deal protection.

criteria.description: 付款人风险与所提供的42%受影响的案例量假设以及潜在的贡献边际减少或现金流中断相关。
criteria.grader_hint: 摘要必须使用所提供的受影响量份额和财务后果来传达重要性。

original.criterion: The payer exposure is tied to the supplied 42% affected case-volume assumption and to potential contribution-margin reduction or cash-flow disruption.
original.grader_hint: The summary must communicate materiality using the supplied affected-volume share and a financial consequence.

criteria.description: 提供商文件公开将当前的许可、特权、资格认证或重新认证以及付款人注册作为提供和计费服务的独特先决条件。

original.criterion: The provider-file exposure addresses current licensure, privileges, credentialing or recredentialing, and payer enrollment as distinct prerequisites for furnishing and billing services.
original.grader_hint: Award when aging files trigger targeted confirmation across these domains rather than a vague request to complete personnel files.

criteria.description: 拟议的麻醉安排保护包括卖方或供应商有关筛查合规性的保证和实际补救措施，例如治愈、审计访问、赔偿或终止权。

original.criterion: The proposed protection for the anesthesia arrangement includes seller or vendor assurances concerning screening compliance and a practical remedy such as cure, audit access, indemnity, or termination rights.

criteria.description: 七年前的监察办审计结案信被明确拒绝作为当前合规性或不存在不相关历史风险的全面证据。

original.criterion: The seven-year-old OIG audit closure letter is explicitly rejected as blanket evidence of current compliance or absence of unrelated historical exposure.
original.grader_hint: The document must actively limit the evidentiary significance of the old letter rather than merely mention its age.

criteria.description: OIG 审计问题要求确认审计范围并结束任何纠正措施、退款、偿还、报告或持续义务。

criteria.description: 请求的陈述和保证足够具体，可以安排，包括材料合规性、许可和参与、排除、计费或超额付款、调查以及所提供的合规信息的准确性（如适用）。

criteria.description: 每个高优先级风险敞口都有一个具体的所有者或负责职能，以及与时间表起草、交割前确认、交割或交割后监控相关的时间触发器。

criteria.description: 该摘要对于非专业读者来说是可以理解的，定义了不可避免的术语或将其置于上下文中，并将监管问题转化为运营和财务后果。

criteria.description: 该工作簿使用1,100计划案例、90天范围、$640每个案例的边际贡献、42%受影响的付款人数量、55%待付款人同意期间的保证金减少以及$18,000筛选补救成本。

original.criterion: The workbook uses 1,100 planned cases, a 90-day horizon, $640 contribution margin per case, 42% affected payer volume, a 55% margin reduction while payer consent is pending, and $18,000 screening remediation cost.
original.grader_hint: Confirm each supplied assumption is present as a numeric value and actually feeds the model calculations.

criteria.description: 基础、预期和下行场景分别使用从合法开放开始测量的0、30和60天的许可延迟以及0、45和90天的付款人同意滞后。

original.criterion: The Base, Expected, and Downside scenarios respectively use license delays of 0, 30, and 60 days and payer-consent lags of 0, 45, and 90 days measured from legal opening.
original.grader_hint: Check both the displayed assumptions and formula behavior; payer lag must begin when the center can legally operate, not at transaction closing.

criteria.description: 该模型将计划病例量均匀分布在 90 天范围内，以便丢失或受影响的病例与适用的天数成正比。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证每日计划量是否等于 1,100 除以 90，无论是否显示该中间值。

original.criterion: The model spreads planned case volume evenly over the 90-day horizon so that cases lost or affected are proportional to the applicable number of days.
original.grader_hint: Verify that daily planned volume is equivalent to 1,100 divided by 90, whether or not that intermediate value is displayed.

criteria.description: 许可延迟风险等于计划案例乘以许可关闭天数除以90 和每个案例的$640 贡献边际。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪公式。基础结果应为零；预计应反映30休息日；下行应该反映60休市日。

original.criterion: License-delay exposure equals planned cases multiplied by license-closed days divided by 90 and by $640 contribution margin per case.
original.grader_hint: Trace the formulas. The Base result should be zero; Expected should reflect 30 closed days; Downside should reflect 60 closed days.

criteria.description: 付款人同意风险仅适用于中心合法开放期间可能发生的案件，从而防止同一案件被计为因关闭而丢失和因未决付款人同意而受到损害。

original.criterion: Payer-consent exposure is applied only to cases that can occur while the center is legally open, preventing the same case from being counted both as lost to closure and impaired by pending payer consent.
original.grader_hint: Confirm affected payer days are capped by the number of open days in the horizon. The Downside scenario should apply payer impairment to 30 open days, not to 90 days of cases.

criteria.description: 付款人同意部分等于适用的开放和待决期间的案件数乘以42%、55% 和$640。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪组件计算并验证完整案例总数和完整保证金都没有被错误地视为丢失。

original.criterion: The payer-consent component equals cases during the applicable open-and-pending period multiplied by 42%, 55%, and $640.
original.grader_hint: Trace the component calculation and verify that neither the full case population nor the full margin is incorrectly treated as lost.

criteria.description: $18,000筛查补救成本在每个场景中包含一次，每次总暴露等于许可延迟损失、付款人同意损失和筛查补救的总和。

original.grader_hint: Check all three scenarios for inclusion exactly once and recompute each displayed total from its components.

criteria.description: Word摘要中引用的每个情景金额或其他预测数字与相应的工作簿结果完全一致，仅受明确指示的整美元四舍五入的影响。

spec.professional_context: Thornbury Studios is preparing to acquire a Texas endoscopy center from Peatmoor Solutions. The director of ambulatory operations must convert fragmented healthcare-compliance concerns into a concise deal-protection summary and a defensible short-term financial estimate for non-specialist decision makers.
difficulty_sources: Materiality triage across overlapping healthcare licensing, exclusion-screening, payer, enrollment, credentialing, and transaction concerns
Distinguishing confirmed deficiencies from contingent liabilities without understating deal risk
Resolving overlap between operational shutdown loss and payer-participation impairment in a 90-day scenario model
Compressing actionable deal protections, owners, timing, uncertainty, and financial consequences into one page
Maintaining exact numerical and terminological consistency across a narrative document and an editable workbook

authoring_plan.mode_intent: Create a normative one-page deal document whose quality depends on a healthcare operations manager knowing which compliance matters can affect lawful operation, historical billing exposure, revenue continuity, and contractual risk allocation. Pair it with a formula-driven estimate that translates supplied operating assumptions into deal-relevant scenarios.
imperfections_and_tensions_to_preserve: Contracted anesthesia personnel have a nine-month exclusion-screening documentation lapse, while the vendor relies on annual attestation. The gold must reject attestation or annual review as an adequate replacement for current and ongoing screening.

A confirmed exclusion match is unlikely but severe. The gold must treat it as a distinct escalation path involving verification, immediate restriction from affected work or billing, a service-and-claims lookback, and fact-based disclosure or repayment analysis.

The state facility license belongs to the seller and does not automatically transfer. The gold must not permit operation after closing without effective buyer authority and should make licensure a closing condition with a lawful contingency.
Payer contracts affecting 42% of cases contain unresolved assignment, change-of-control, notice, or consent language. The gold must avoid assuming uniform continuity.
An old federal audit closure letter has limited scope and age. The gold must not treat it as blanket proof of current compliance or absence of unrelated historical liabilities.

Laboratory certification, state facility licensure, Medicare enrollment or supplier status, accreditation, provider credentials, and payer enrollment are separate dependencies and must not be collapsed into one approval.

The financial estimate lacks facts needed to value repayments, penalties, settlements, or legal fees. Those categories remain explicitly unquantified rather than assigned zero as a substantive conclusion.

gold_relationships.daily_planned_cases: Planned case volume divided by the 90-day horizon.
gold_relationships.license_delay_loss: Planned cases multiplied by license-delay days divided by 90, then multiplied by contribution margin per case.
gold_relationships.open_days: The greater of zero and 90 minus license-delay days.
gold_relationships.payer_affected_days: The lesser of payer-consent lag and open days because payer impairment begins only when legal operation begins and cannot affect cases already lost to closure.
gold_relationships.payer_consent_loss: Daily planned cases multiplied by payer-affected days, affected payer share, contribution-margin reduction percentage, and contribution margin per case.
gold_relationships.scenario_total: License-delay loss plus payer-consent loss plus one screening-remediation cost.
gold_relationships.base_inputs: Zero license-delay days and zero payer-consent-lag days.
gold_relationships.expected_inputs: Thirty license-delay days and forty-five payer-consent-lag days.
gold_relationships.downside_inputs: Sixty license-delay days and ninety payer-consent-lag days, capped to the thirty open days remaining in the horizon.
gold_relationships.cross_file_rule: Any workbook output quoted in the one-page summary must match the workbook, allowing only transparent whole-dollar rounding.

professional_content_expected: Deal materiality triage tied to economics, conditions precedent, and targeted agreement protections.
Current and monthly exclusion screening of relevant individuals and entities using federal and applicable state sources, with buyer verification over delegated screening.
Separate response for a credible or confirmed exclusion match, including immediate control, retrospective claims review, and counsel-guided reporting or repayment assessment.
Facility licensure as a prerequisite to operation and a closing condition, with a lawful delay contingency.
Separate treatment of laboratory certification, Medicare enrollment or supplier continuity, accreditation, payer contracting, and provider credentialing.
Contract-specific payer consent analysis and a quantified revenue effect based only on the supplied assumptions.
Limited reliance on historical audit closure documentation and confirmation of scope, corrective actions, refunds, reporting, and continuing obligations.
Specific representations, warranties, indemnity or escrow concepts, accountable functions, and timing.
Plain-language explanations suitable for non-specialists and calibrated statements of uncertainty.
workbook_behavior: Inputs must be editable numeric cells and scenario outputs must be formula-driven.
The model must prevent overlap between cases lost during license closure and cases financially impaired while open but awaiting payer consent.
The supplied remediation cost is included exactly once in every scenario.
Unsupported contingent liabilities are excluded from quantified totals with an explicit explanation that they remain unquantified pending facts.
A test edit to a major assumption must propagate through all affected outputs.
authoring_plan.intended_verdict: A passing reference solution fits on one rendered Word page, identifies the small set of compliance matters that can alter the transaction, actively corrects the annual-attestation misuse, isolates the severe exclusion-match exception, makes lawful operation contingent on effective licensing, and provides a transparent three-scenario workbook whose values reconcile exactly with the summary.

deliverables.description: One-page, plain-language pre-closing summary of compliance exposures material to price, closing conditions, or agreement protections.
constraints: Must be no more than one rendered page, be current as of March 1, 2025, address the Texas transaction, distinguish known facts from unresolved matters, and use exactly the specified filename at the top level of the working directory.

deliverables.description: Editable 90-day Base, Expected, and Downside estimate of the identified operational compliance exposures.
constraints: Must use editable assumptions and formulas, must not assign unsupported values to repayments, penalties, legal fees, or settlements, must agree with every shared figure in the Word summary, and must use exactly the specified filename at the top level of the working directory.

original_instruction:
You’re the director of ambulatory operations at Thornbury Studios, supporting its purchase of the Texas endoscopy center operated by Peatmoor Solutions. Solveig Sinclair needs a decision-ready compliance view before deal counsel drafts the representation-and-warranty schedules this Friday, and closing is three weeks away. The data room is about 600 pages of payer contracts, Texas facility and federal laboratory records, three years of anesthesia staffing agreements, an old OIG audit letter, and provider files, but she does not want a diligence index or a generic list of everything that might be wrong. She wants only the exposures that could reasonably change the price, become a closing condition, or require a specific representation, warranty, indemnity, or escrow. Prepare the work as of March 1, 2025, applying the requirements relevant to a Texas ambulatory surgery center and its federal program participation. The summary will go to non-specialist investment committee members as well as counsel, so it must be understandable without assuming healthcare-compliance vocabulary.

There are several tensions you need to resolve rather than simply repeat. The anesthesia group has not documented exclusion screening for its clinicians during the last nine months, although its administrator says an annual contractual attestation is sufficient. The operations team regards this as inexpensive housekeeping, while counsel is concerned about services already billed. The compliance vice president also says a confirmed exclusion match is too unlikely to deserve treatment separate from ordinary screening remediation. State counsel has flagged that the current Texas facility license is issued to the seller and will not automatically transfer on the change of ownership, but the integration plan assumes uninterrupted operations from the first morning after closing. Several payer agreements cover 42% of projected cases and contain change-of-control, assignment, or notice language that has not yet been resolved. The seller points to a seven-year-old OIG audit closure letter as evidence that no historical compliance representation is needed. There is also a CLIA certificate for the center’s limited laboratory testing, aging credentialing material in some provider files, and no consolidated account of what happens to Medicare enrollment, accreditation, or payer participation at closing.

Please produce two files: (1) `preclosing_compliance_exposure_summary.docx`, limited to one page, that prioritizes the deal-relevant exposures, states what deal protection each one warrants, and makes clear what is known versus what still needs confirmation; and (2) `deal_exposure_forecast.xlsx`, an editable 90-day estimate showing Base, Expected, and Downside scenarios. For the forecast, use 1,100 planned cases spread evenly across the 90 days, contribution margin of $640 per case, an $18,000 exclusion-screening remediation cost in every scenario, and license-delay assumptions of 0, 30, and 60 days respectively. Pair those with payer-consent lags of 0, 45, and 90 days measured from the first day the center is legally open. During an open day while consent is pending, apply the payer issue only to the 42% affected case volume and model a 55% reduction in contribution margin for those cases. Do not assign assumed dollar values to repayments, penalties, legal fees, or settlement exposure where the necessary claims facts are unavailable; identify that uncertainty without manufacturing precision.

The two files must agree on every figure they share, including the 90-day scenario exposure quoted for decision-making. Keep the Word document to the material call, not background education, and make the spreadsheet transparent enough that Oona Voskresensky can change an assumption without rebuilding it. Write both files into the top level of the working directory you start in, using exactly the filenames above.
